messages.author: swarm
messages.text: BL-586 🎵 in progress — Pipeline board topic identity is fragile — crossed onto a support thread, minted zombie topics, and survived file-level repair via in-memory state

messages.author: swarm
messages.text: BL-586 ✅ done — The pipeline board trusts its stored topic id without ever validating it, and mints a fresh topic whenever that id is cleared - so it has twice ended up posting (and pinning) into the human's support thread while spawning untracked zombie topics
